text: The account PK**MUCB****6560 belonging to Tariq Naveed was opened on 30 December 2020. The customer is a Medical sales officer (salaried) with a declared monthly income of PKR 220,000 per month. During the period from 2 June 2026 to 25 June 2026 the account recorded 14 credits totalling PKR 19,311,000 and 4 debits totalling PKR 14,618,000. The activity comprised 13 cash deposits totalling PKR 19,091,000 made across four branches (Clifton Branch, DHA Phase 6 Branch, Gulshan-e-Iqbal Branch, Saddar Branch). An alert was raised on 25 June 2026 by Tazama, which assigned a STR-PK-01 typology score of 320 against a threshold of 300. Nine of the 13 cash deposits (69%) were between PKR 1,600,000 and PKR 1,999,999, i.e., just below the cash transaction reporting threshold of PKR 2,000,000, consistent with the structuring hypothesis. The credits in the activity window were 87.8 times the declared monthly income of PKR 220,000 per month, indicating a cash volume inconsistent with the declared income, as noted in the structuring hypothesis. Overall, the pattern of multiple near‑threshold cash deposits across several branches, amounting to volumes far exceeding the declared income of PKR 220,000 per month, is consistent with suspected structuring. PKR 7,825,000 was transferred in two transactions to Crescent Imports (PK**CRES****1592, Synthetic Bank C). PKR 6,793,000 was transferred in two transactions to Sheraz Traders (PK**SHER****1518, Synthetic Bank A). Debits amounted to 76% of credits, with a median of 28.4 hours between the latest credit and each debit. Screening on 28 June 2026 found no matches on sanctions, politically exposed persons or adverse media. On 28 June 2026 the account was placed under enhanced monitoring pending a reporting decision, with no contact made with the customer about this review.
